segments.he: אַרְבַּע מִדּוֹת בַּמּוֹכְרִין: מָכַר לוֹ חִטִּין יָפוֹת וְנִמְצְאוּ רָעוֹת – הַלּוֹקֵחַ יָכוֹל לַחֲזוֹר בּוֹ. רָעוֹת וְנִמְצְאוּ יָפוֹת – מוֹכֵר יָכוֹל לַחֲזוֹר בּוֹ. רָעוֹת וְנִמְצְאוּ רָעוֹת; יָפוֹת וְנִמְצְאוּ יָפוֹת – אֵין אֶחָד מֵהֶם יָכוֹל לַחֲזוֹר בּוֹ.
segments.en: There are «four» basic «cases with regard to sellers» and buyers. If the seller «sold him wheat» and said that the wheat was «good, and it is found» to be «bad, the buyer,» but not the seller, «can renege on» the sale. If the seller sold him what he thought was «bad» wheat «and it is found» to be «good, the seller can renege on» the sale but the buyer cannot. If he sold «bad» wheat «and it is found» to be «bad,» or «good» wheat «and it is found» to be «good, neither one of them can renege on» the sale, as the condition of the sale was met.

segments.he: שְׁחַמְתִּית וְנִמְצֵאת לְבָנָה, לְבָנָה וְנִמְצֵאת שְׁחַמְתִּית; עֵצִים שֶׁל זַיִת וְנִמְצְאוּ שֶׁל שִׁקְמָה, שֶׁל שִׁקְמָה וְנִמְצְאוּ שֶׁל זַיִת; יַיִן וְנִמְצָא חוֹמֶץ, חוֹמֶץ וְנִמְצָא יַיִן – שְׁנֵיהֶם יְכוֹלִין לַחֲזוֹר בָּהֶן.
segments.en: If the seller sold «reddish-brown» wheat «and it is found» to be «white,» or «white» wheat «and it is found» to be «reddish-brown,» and similarly, if he sold «olive wood and it is found» to be wood «of a sycamore,» or he sold wood «of a sycamore and it is found» to be wood «of an olive» tree, or if the seller sold him «wine and it is found» to be «vinegar,» or «vinegar and it is found» to be «wine,» in all of these cases «both» the seller and the buyer «can renege on» the sale. Since the sale was for a different item than that which was delivered, the transaction can be nullified even if there was no mistake with regard to the price.

positions.claim: quality mismatch lets the disadvantaged party renege; a mismatch of kind lets both renege
